output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The freezeAccount function has an access control issue, allowing only the owner to freeze a user's account.
The setPrices function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the prices of the tokens to any arbitrary value.
The buy function has an integer overflow where the amount of ether sent is checked by the buyPrice, allowing potential unhandled cases of zero or invalid user input.
The sell function has an integer overflow where the amount of user input is used to perform a trade without checking the balance of the user's account, potentially resulting in loss of funds.
The burn function has an access control issue, allowing only the owner to burn a user's account.
